## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数字（来自 press_release.txt 财报表格，Three Months Ended June 30）：**
- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）：**$39,306 百万**
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）：**$29,878 百万**

**计算过程：**
- 同比增长额 = $39,306M − $29,878M = **$9,428M**
- 同比增长率 = $9,428M ÷ $29,878M × 100% = **31.55%**，微软四舍五入披露为 **32%**（按固定汇率口径为 31%，汇率影响约 $80M）

**出处**：press_release.txt 第 ~18895 位的财报分部表格；metrics.txt 第 775 位的 Azure 增长率（43%/43%）亦交叉印证。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

**出处**：transcript.txt 第 ~24808 位起，Satya Nadella 对 Intelligent Cloud 分部的发言：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

此外，对 on-premises server 业务也有提及：
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

### 3. 归因中"已发生事实"与"前瞻性表述"的区分

| # | 归因表述 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---------|------|---------|
| 1 | Azure 收入增长 43% | **已发生事实** | 对已结束季度（Q4 FY26）的业绩披露，有具体数字 |
| 2 | Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity | **已发生事实（现状描述）** | 用现在时态"continues"描述 Q4 期间已观察到的供需状态，是当期业绩的背景解释 |
| 3 | Efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet | **已发生事实** | "gains" 用过去时，指 Q4 已实现的效率改进 |
| 4 | Process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity | **已发生事实** | "improvements…enable" 指 Q4 已落地并产生效果的流程改进 |
| 5 | That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized | **已发生事实** | "was monetized" 明确为过去完成时，描述 Q4 内已实现的变现 |
| 6 | Stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change | **已发生事实** | "June business model change" 是已落地事件，"consumption" 是 Q4 已实现的消费数据 |
| 7 | On-premises server renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition | **已发生事实** | 对 Q4 已签合同的收入确认描述 |
| 8 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **前瞻性表述** | 出现"remain focused on…bridge the gaps"，指向未来持续的行动目标 |
| 9 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | 明确用"continue to expect"，是对未来 H1（FY27 上半年）的预测 |
| 10 | Q1 FY27 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引 $40.95–$41.25B，增长 33–34%；Azure 增长约 45%（固定汇率） | **前瞻性表述** | 出现"we expect"，是对未来一个季度的定量指引 |

**区分核心判断标准**：
- **时态与措辞**：过去时态（grew, was, was monetized, followed）→ 已发生事实；现在进行/持续状态（continues, remain focused）→ 现状事实；将来/预期措辞（expect, continue to expect, focused on delivering）→ 前瞻性表述。
- **数据属性**：有具体历史数字（$39.3B、43%）为事实；带区间预测（$40.95–$41.25B、33%–34%、~45%）为前瞻性指引。
- **业务模型变更（June business model change）**：6 月已实施为事实，但其带来的消费效应在 Q4 体现部分为事实，对未来的持续影响属前瞻性。

---

### 结论

Intelligent Cloud FY26 Q4 收入 **$39,306M**，同比增长 **32%**（按报表口径；固定汇率 31%），增长主要已实现归因于：Azure 43% 增长、CPU/GPU 效率提升、新产能提前交付变现、GitHub Copilot 业务模式变更后的强劲消费，以及本地服务器合同续签中的收入确认结构。这些多为**已发生事实**；而面向未来 H1 Azure 增速加速、Q1 FY27 指引 $40.95–$41.25B 等则属**管理层前瞻性表述**，投资者需注意"需求持续超过供给"虽为现状描述，但其解决方案（bridging the gaps）仍是未来承诺，存在执行不确定性。
